subject.title: [Feature] Allow configuring Gemini safety settings in OpenClaw

question: Should OpenClaw expose Gemini safety-filter overrides, and should the permanent contract live in Google plugin-owned configuration or the generic model-provider schema?
rationale: The capability intentionally changes provider safety policy and adds a compatibility-sensitive public configuration surface; repository policy cannot determine that product choice automatically.

options.title: Google-owned typed config
options.body: Add a validated Google plugin-owned setting with optional per-model overrides, documented safety implications, and narrowly scoped request injection.

options.title: Generic provider field
options.body: Add safetySettings to models.providers entries and define which google-generative-ai-compatible providers receive it, accepting the broader compatibility contract.

options.title: Do not expose overrides
options.body: Keep provider defaults and explicit application-level request behavior as the safety boundary, then close the feature request.

recommendation.title: Google-owned typed config
recommendation.body: Add a validated Google plugin-owned setting with optional per-model overrides, documented safety implications, and narrowly scoped request injection.

likelyOwner.reason: This person already provided the clearest issue-level routing signal and has recent history across the affected config and Google transport surfaces.
